description: Order city/area rows by Thai venue count, mean FHRS rating or venues per 100k residents. Use for 'which city has the most or the best'. Rating ranking excludes Scottish areas, which report Pass/Improvement Required instead of a score, and rows with small samples can top it - each row returns n so the sample can be judged. Names are dataset area names, which are sometimes councils rather than towns.
name: rank_cities
title: City league table
